result.summary: Found 2 minor issues: an accessibility visibility concern for interactive elements and a styling contrast issue with placeholder text.

issues.description: The heart (favorite) buttons on restaurant cards have low visibility against variable dark image backgrounds (such as the bottom pizza card), reducing their discoverability for users with visual impairments.
issues.suggestion: Add a semi-transparent background, outline, or shadow to the heart buttons to maintain visibility against all image backgrounds.

issues.description: The search bar placeholder text uses a light gray color with insufficient contrast against the light gray background of the search field.
issues.suggestion: Darken the placeholder text color to meet WCAG contrast accessibility standards.
